subject: Emotions
title: Pathogen Disgust
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Pathogen Disgust.

hook.text: Feces, vomit, rotting flesh—the things that disgust us most are the things most likely to carry disease.

buildup.text: Pathogen disgust is the original form. It evolved to keep us away from parasites and bacteria.

discovery.text: Val Curtis found that the top disgust triggers worldwide match the top disease vectors exactly.

twist.text: Cultures with more disease burden have stronger pathogen disgust. The environment tunes the emotion.

climax.text: Hand-washing campaigns succeed by triggering disgust, not by explaining germ theory.

punchline.text: Disgust taught hygiene long before science did.

quiz.question: What did Val Curtis find about disgust triggers?
